motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Marcia Vasquez for Library Board Advisor for a Three -year Term begi…
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to approve the appointment of Marcia Vasquez for Library Board Advisor for a Three -year Term beginning January 2026 through December 31, 202 8. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Library board seat for Marcia Vasquez
motions.summary: The council took up appointing Marcia Vasquez as a library board advisor for a three-year term through December 2028; the record does not show the result.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents either way — this is a volunteer advisory seat tied to the city library.

motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Mandy Lane for Planning Commissioner for a One-year Term beginning J…
motions.motion: Councilmember Huish moved to approve the appointment of Mandy Lane for Planning Commissioner for a One-year Term beginning January 2026 through December 31, 202 6. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Mandy Lane appointed to planning commission
motions.summary: The council appointed Mandy Lane to the planning commission for a one-year term through December 2026.
motions.impact: Routine housekeeping — nothing changes day to day. She joins the board that reviews zoning and development proposals before they reach the council.

motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Chad Decoursey for Planning Commission Alternate for a Three -year T…
motions.motion: Councilmember Huish moved to approve the appointment of Chad Decoursey for Planning Commission Alternate for a Three -year Term beginning January 2026 through December 31, 202 8. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Chad Decoursey named planning commission alternate
motions.summary: The council appointed Chad Decoursey as an alternate on the planning commission for a three-year term running through December 2028.
motions.impact: Routine housekeeping — nothing changes for residents. An alternate fills in on the board that reviews zoning and development proposals when a regular member cannot attend.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the batch of items passed together in a single vote without separate discussion.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents on its own — consent items are the routine business the council clears all at once.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Appointing the Eagle Mountain City Recorder
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Appointing Lacie Messerly as the Eagle Mountain City Recorder . Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Lacie Messerly named city recorder
motions.summary: The council appointed Lacie Messerly as Eagle Mountain's city recorder.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents — the recorder is the staff position that keeps the city's official records and meeting minutes.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 2.45 regarding Youth Council.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 2.45 regarding Youth Council with updated revisions made in Work Session. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Youth Council rules rewritten
motions.summary: The council rewrote the section of city code that sets up and governs the Youth Council, with revisions worked out earlier the same night.
motions.impact: This touches only the teens who serve on the Youth Council and those applying to join. For everyone else it is internal housekeeping.

motions.item_title: A pprove the Minor Site Plan for the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange with the following conditio…
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to a pprove the Minor Site Plan for the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange with the following conditions: • The Dynamic Fitness and Strength equipment bid dated January 13, 2026 , be completed as proposed ; and • The Hidden H ollow Wellness Center and Outdoor G athering Amenity Area be completed as presented in the packet; and • The clubhouse contains at least one am enity as required by City Code ; and • The item will be brought back to the City Council for approval through a n Agreement . Councilmember Huish seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Hidden Hollow amenity swap approved
motions.summary: The city approved a site plan letting the Hidden Hollow development swap amenities for a wellness center, outdoor gathering area, and new fitness equipment.
motions.impact: If you live in Hidden Hollow, the amenities your neighborhood gets are changing, and the clubhouse must still include at least one amenity. The final terms come back to the council in a written agreement.

motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved that a code requirement for any amenity exchange requests be made early in the process be added to the Legislative Priorities List . Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Amenity swap rules added to code to-do list
motions.summary: The council put a future code change on its legislative priorities list requiring developers to request amenity exchanges early in the approval process.
motions.impact: Nothing changes yet — this only adds the rule to the city's list of code updates to write later. If it is eventually adopted, developers swapping promised neighborhood amenities would have to ask sooner.
